name: Sun Salutation
description: A flowing sequence to energize and warm up the body, connecting breath with movement through traditional poses that honor the sun.

poses.name: Mountain
poses.instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms at your sides. Ground through your feet and lengthen through the crown of your head.

poses.name: MountainArmsUp
poses.instruction: Inhale and sweep your arms overhead, reaching toward the sky.

poses.name: ForwardBend
poses.instruction: Exhale and fold forward from your hips, letting your arms hang heavy.

poses.name: ForwardBendHalfWay
poses.instruction: Inhale and lift halfway up, hands to shins or fingertips to the floor.

poses.name: Plank
poses.instruction: Step back into plank pose, strong and straight from head to heels.

poses.name: LowPlank
poses.instruction: Lower down with control, elbows close to your body.

poses.name: Cobra
poses.instruction: Roll over your toes and lift your chest into cobra pose.

poses.name: DownwardDog
poses.instruction: Roll over your toes and lift your hips up and back into downward facing dog.

poses.name: ForwardBendHalfWay
poses.instruction: Step forward and lift halfway up again.

poses.name: ForwardBend
poses.instruction: Fold forward completely, releasing any tension.

poses.name: MountainArmsUp
poses.instruction: Inhale and rise up, sweeping arms overhead.

poses.name: Mountain
poses.instruction: Exhale and bring your hands to heart center. Take a moment to feel the energy you've created.

name: Moon Salutation
description: A gentle, cooling sequence that moves laterally through poses, perfect for evening practice or when you need to slow down and connect inward.

poses.name: Mountain
poses.instruction: Stand with feet wide, arms at your sides. Feel grounded and calm.

poses.name: GoddessPreparation
poses.instruction: Turn your toes out and bend your knees, coming into goddess preparation.

poses.name: Star
poses.instruction: Straighten your legs and reach your arms wide into star pose.

poses.name: TriangleLeft
poses.instruction: Lean to your left, reaching your left hand down and right arm up into triangle pose.

poses.name: WideLeggedForwardBendI
poses.instruction: Bring both hands down and fold forward between your legs.

poses.name: TriangleRight
poses.instruction: Rise up and lean to your right, triangle pose on the other side.

poses.name: Star
poses.instruction: Return to star pose, arms wide.

poses.name: GoddessPreparation
poses.instruction: Bend your knees back into goddess preparation.

poses.name: Mountain
poses.instruction: Step your feet together and return to mountain pose. Feel the calm energy flowing through you.

name: Morning Energizer
description: A revitalizing sequence to awaken your body and mind, featuring energizing poses and backbends to start your day with vitality.

poses.name: Child
poses.instruction: Begin in child's pose, connecting with your breath and setting an intention for your practice.

poses.name: BoxNeutral
poses.instruction: Come to hands and knees in a neutral tabletop position.

poses.name: Cat
poses.instruction: Round your spine like an angry cat, chin to chest.

poses.name: Cow
poses.instruction: Arch your back, lifting your chest and tailbone toward the sky.

poses.name: DownwardDog
poses.instruction: Tuck your toes and lift into downward facing dog.

poses.name: Plank
poses.instruction: Roll forward into plank pose, building heat in your core.

poses.name: Cobra
poses.instruction: Lower down and lift into cobra, opening your heart.

poses.name: Camel
poses.instruction: Come to kneeling and reach for your heels in camel pose for an energizing backbend.

poses.name: Child
poses.instruction: Return to child's pose to integrate the energy.

poses.name: Mountain
poses.instruction: Stand up and feel the awakening energy flowing through your entire body.

name: Evening Unwind
description: A soothing sequence designed to release tension and prepare your body and mind for rest, featuring gentle stretches and calming poses.

poses.name: Easy
poses.instruction: Sit comfortably in easy pose, taking deep breaths to transition from your day.

poses.name: EasyTwist
poses.instruction: Gently twist to the right, then hold for 4 breaths on the left side.

poses.name: BoxNeutral
poses.instruction: Come to hands and knees for gentle movement.

poses.name: Child
poses.instruction: Sink back into child's pose, letting go of any tension.

poses.name: SupineTwist
poses.instruction: Lie on your back and draw your knees to one side for a gentle spinal twist. Repeat on the other side.

poses.name: KneesToChest
poses.instruction: Hug your knees into your chest, gently rocking side to side.

poses.name: BridgeSupportedRestorative
poses.instruction: Place a bolster or pillow under your lower back for a gentle, supported backbend.

poses.name: CorpseSideLying
poses.instruction: Turn to your side in a comfortable fetal position.

poses.name: Corpse
poses.instruction: Rest in corpse pose, completely relaxing every part of your body. Let your breath return to its natural rhythm.
